violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 2DR upright cooler: mashed potatoes (44f), cheese sauce (45f) 2) at ambient temperature: original sauce (51f), sweet sauce (54f), spicy sauce (53f) Upon discussion with PIC, sauces at ambient temperature was placed out 1.5 hours prior to inspection
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE MASHED POTATOES AND CHEESE SAUCE. PIC AGREED TO DISCARD THE SAUCES AT AMBIENT TEMPERATURE 2.5 HOURS LATER.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Observed two unlabeled spray bottles of cleaning chemicals in the dish washing area.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. STAFF LABLED THE SPRAY BOTTLES AS BLEACH AND DEGREASER. ALL CHEMICAL BOTTLES MUST BE LABELED.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction, Farm-Raised
violations.observation: Observed no parasite destruction letter for the salmon.
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form and the fish is raised and fed as specified by Law, a written agreement or statement from the supplier or aquaculturist stipulating that the fish were raised and fed shall be obtained by the person in charge and retained in the records for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. CONTACT THE SALMON SUPPLIER TO OBTAIN THE PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER. CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: 1) honey mustard; 2) honey sriracha; 3) teriyaki
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO DISCARD THE SAUCES. SAUCES WERE DISCARDED.

violations.observation: Observed two unlabeled spray bottles of cleaning products.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. PIC LABELED THE SPRAY BOTTLES AS DEGREASER AND BLEACH.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) the sanitizer dispenser at the upstairs 3 compartment sink; 2) the sanitizer dispenser used to fill red buckets (on the opposite wall of the 3 compartment sink); high temperature dish machine
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. CONTACT THE SERVICE COMPANY TO RECALIBRATE THE SANITIZER DISPENSERS. CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION. DISCONTINUE USING THE HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH MACHINE FOR SANITIZING. MANUALLY SANITIZE ALL DISHES IN THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: The walls under the main dish area was observed heavily discolored. The pipes under the tankless water heater were observed with an accumulation of grease and dust.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. MORE FREQUENT AND ROUTINE CLEANING IS REQUIRED. CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Ventilation System Cleaning
violations.observation: Observed the hood system above the kettle with food splatter. Observed the air vent in the main dish washing areas with accumulated dust. Observed grease drippings on the main hood system over the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Clean intake and exhaust air ducts at regularly intervals to prevent them from becoming sources of contamination. MORE FREQUENT AND ROUTINE CLEANING IS REQUIRED. CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer bucket in the main kitchen was observed at 500ppm.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. PIC EMPTIED THE BUCKET AND REFILLED IT WITH THE QUATERNARY AMMONIUM MACHINE AT THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK. SANITIZER BUCKET WAS OBSERVED IN BETWEEN 200ppm-400ppm.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: Observed aluminum foil lining table tops and shelves in the prep kitchen (basement)
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. REMOVE ALL FOIL TO FACILITATE PROPER CLEANING.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: the chemical dish machine at the bar was observed not sanitizing.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. DISCONTINUE THE USE OF THIS DISH MACHINE UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED AND SANITIZING APPROPRIATELY. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO PUT A ‘DO NOT USE’ SIGN ON IT.
